newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds can push on, 111-19 first barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds can push on, 111-19 first barrier.

text.p: September T-bond futures can push ahead on Friday after breaking out of the top of the recent range in the previous session, technical analysts said.
"It's going to go flat into the U.S. open but everything supports the uptrend," Nicholas Rose, technical analyst at 4CAST in London, said.

T-bonds were quote at 111-11 at 1140 GMT, down 1/32 in automated trade. On Thursday, they shot around 3/4 of a point higher on weaker-than-expected retail sales data, taking out the June 6 high at 111-09.
Rose said resistance at 111-19 came from an uptrend connecting the May highs.
Beyond there, the 111-27,28 area would form a barrier. That area represents a 62 percent Fibonacci retracement of the drop from the December to April decline.
The next target up was the 113-09 February high, he said.
"It is difficult though because if we get a bad set of figures everything ratchets down again," he said.
David Wood, independent technical analyst in London said the market was approaching a top.
He too said 111-27,29 was a barrier.
"If we can spike through there, then there is a possibility we could run up to 113-09," he said on Reuters Financial Television.
Rose put initial support at 111-05, from the bottom of the range in Thursday's trade after the contract burst higher.
Wood saw solid resistance around 110-12, the platform this week's extension.
September Eurodollars were quoted at 94.120, unchanged in the session.
